# Every `extern "C"` entry point the C ABI exports, one per line, sorted.
#
# The surface a host binding declares in its own language, as data rather than
# as Rust source. A `flz_core_ffi` test holds it equal to the crate's exports
# and to its one surface table, `veneer::SURFACE`; each SDK's own surface test
# holds its hand-written declaration to it (PHP's `AbiSurfaceTest`, Python's
# `test_native.py`, Ruby's `native_test.rb`, Node's `native.test.mjs`, the
# Elixir SDK's `native_surface_test.exs`). A binding that reads the crate's
# source instead cannot run outside a checkout of it, which is the whole
# reason this file exists.
#
# Adding an entry point: the function in `flz_core_ffi/src/lib.rs`, `local.rs`
# or `notice.rs`, its veneer function, its row in `veneer::SURFACE`, its line
# here, and one wrapper in every host binding (docs/public/architecture/runner.md).

flz_core_admin_call
flz_core_buf_free
flz_core_check_class
flz_core_complete
flz_core_context_free
flz_core_context_new
